newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps downgrades Turkish banks.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps downgrades Turkish banks.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Monday it downgraded the foreign currency or local currency debt ratings of five Turkish banks.
The rating actions resulted from the agency's decisions to downgrade to Double B Minus from Double B the credit rating of the long-term foreign currency obligations of the Turkish government.
-- Demirbank TAS, long-term foreign currency debt downgraded to Double B Minus from Double B.
-- Garanti Birinci, long-term local currency downgraded to Triple B Plus from Single A Minus; short-term local currency debt cut to Duff Two from Duff One Minus.
-- Alternatifbank, long-term foreign currency debt cut to Double B Minus from Double B.

-- Korfezbank, long-term foreign currency debt cut to Double B Minus from Double B; long-term local currency debt cut to Triple B Plus from Single A Minus; short-term local currency debt cut to Duff Two from Duff One Minus.
-- Turk Ekonomi Bankasi, long-term foreign currency debt cut to Double B Minus from Double B; long-term local currency debt cut to Triple B Plus from Single A Minus.
